headline_tolerance_rationale: The README prints every gap to 3 significant figures (50.0, 51.6, 22.2, 14.1, 9.9). rel_tol is half a unit in the last printed digit divided by the claimed value, the largest relative error a correctly rounded print can carry (1.0e-3 for 50.0 up to 5.1e-3 for 9.9). The exact test is rounds_to_claimed: the recomputed value, rounded half-up to the claim's decimals, equals the claim. Status requires that test, which is never looser than the gate's rel_tol check.
gap_definition: PROTOCOL.md Metric: per size, ratio of the mean over curves of per-curve mean total cost (GAE at weight w) of the IC arm to that of its matched rho on the same curves. The ratio of mean S = cost/sqrt(r) (variant A) is reported as a sensitivity; it does not reproduce the README (e.g. torsion ic-b b40 w0 = 50.3012).

bootstrap_intervals_not_gated.note: Monte Carlo, not gated. The README intervals agree with independent resampling of IC and rho curves to within resampling noise; paired resampling (same curves for both arms) is narrower. Every lower bound at b40 exceeds 1 under both.

instances.method: From p and #E only (curve coefficients are not in raw/). q = p^2, T = q + 1 - #E. Aut(E) > {+-1} needs j in {0, 1728}, which for ordinary E needs 4q - T^2 = 3b^2 (j = 0) or 4b^2 (j = 1728). j in F_p (j != 0, 1728) needs T = t^2 - 2p (base change) or T = 2p - t^2 (quadratic twist, GLS). Both tests are necessary conditions: a failed test excludes the structure; a passed test does not prove it.
